name: JSON
summary: JSON parser, writer and path access for DICTs and arrays, in pure GBX.
description: Parses JSON text into dictionaries and arrays, reads and writes values through string paths like player.inventory[2].name, builds documents from code and serializes them back to compact or pretty JSON. Objects become DICTs, arrays become index-keyed DICTs, so the whole document can also be walked with DICT_COUNT/DICT_KEY$/DICT_VALUE. Pure GBX: runs in the interpreter, in a built EXE and in the HTML5 player.
author: GameBasiX
